shabos-rent.title: ShabbosRent
shabos-rent.tagline: Halakhic Prop-Tech, Reciprocal Apartment Swap & Affiliate ERP
shabos-rent.summary: An enterprise-grade hospitality and accommodation ecosystem engineered specifically for the global Shabbat-observant community. Features walking-distance calculation via the Haversine formula (4.8 km/h), reciprocal home exchange, multi-tier dual commission affiliate modeling, and an omnichannel administrative ERP.

images.label: Screen 01 — Landing Hero & Walking Distance Search
images.caption: Consumer search experience with pedestrian walking-distance radius filter to synagogues, Torah portion selectors, and Rent vs. Swap modes.

images.label: Screen 02 — Administrative ERP & Analytics Dashboard
images.caption: Platform operator console tracking 1,520+ total apartments, active listings, monthly revenue metrics, and city-level search demand.

images.label: Screen 03 — Ambassador Affiliate & Commission Portal
images.caption: Promoter portal with Model A vs B selection, 7-day model lock alerts, referral link generation, and approved balance ledger.

comparison.sectionTitle: Why Traditional Platforms (Airbnb, Booking) Fail in this Market
comparison.sectionDesc: General hospitality software is fundamentally unaware of Halakhic (Jewish religious law) constraints. ShabbosRent was architected from the ground up to solve these specialized lifestyle requirements.

items.title: Walking vs Driving Transit
items.traditional: Calculates radius in driving minutes or radial km — useless on Shabbat when driving is prohibited.
items.solution: Halakhic Pedestrian Engine: Calculates walking minutes to synagogues & landmarks using Haversine formula at 4.8 km/h.

items.title: Religious Amenities
items.traditional: Filters only for generic amenities (pools, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, parking).
items.solution: Kosher Kitchen (separate meat/dairy), Shabbos Plata, Hot Water Urn, Shabbos Timer, Shabbos Elevator, Sukkah Balcony.

items.title: Liturgical Calendar
items.traditional: Bookings operate strictly on civil Gregorian calendar dates.
items.solution: Torah Portion (Parshiyot) Integration: Availability syncs with liturgical weekends (e.g., Parshat Bereshit, Yom Tov).

items.title: Holiday Lodging Costs
items.traditional: Surge pricing causes prices to multiply 3x–5x during Jewish high holidays.
items.solution: Reciprocal Apartment Swap: Verified homeowners exchange properties between cities (Jerusalem ↔ Bnei Brak) at zero lodging cost.

items.title: Orthodox Digital Divide
items.traditional: Assumes 100% smartphone and public internet app accessibility.
items.solution: Omnichannel Bridge: IVR telephone hotline with AI speech transcription and 1-click printable PDF synagogue bulletin flyers.

details.heading: Haversine Pedestrian Transit Formula
details.text: Calculates Great-Circle distance to key landmarks (Western Wall / Kotel, Great Synagogue, Geula, Rehavia, Nachlaot, Tzfat Old City) mapped to calibrated walking velocity: 4.8 km/h (1 km ≈ 12.5 mins). Allows strict filtering: 5, 10, 15, or 20-minute walking radii.

details.heading: Specialized Halakhic & Architecture Filters
details.text: Explicit filtering for Kosher Kitchen (Meat/Dairy separate sinks), Shabbos Plata (hot plate), Continuous Hot Water Urn, automated light timers, Shabbat elevator, and Sukkah Balcony (open to sky).

details.heading: Direct WhatsApp & Phone Dispatch
details.text: Features phone sanitization and 1-click WhatsApp/Call hotline dispatch with courtesy reminder: 'Please remind the host you found them via ShabbosRent so we can keep maintaining the site.'

details.heading: Mutual Swap Verification Gate
details.text: Users can only initiate swaps if they hold an active, verified apartment listing of their own with swap availability toggled to true. Both participating hosts must be verified.

details.heading: Side-by-Side Comparison UI
details.text: Interactive modal allowing users to inspect 'Your Listing' alongside 'Target Listing' (Bedrooms, Capacity, Kosher status, Walking proximity) before dispatching a proposal.

details.heading: Two-Way Confirmation & Unique Swap Codes
details.text: Generates cryptographic swap codes (e.g. SWP-1042) once Host B approves Host A's proposal, securely unmasking private key-exchange contact details.

subsystems.title: Affiliate & Dual Commission Engine
subsystems.subtitle: Per-Apartment Dual Models & Immutable Accounting Ledger

details.heading: Model A vs. Model B (Configured Per Apartment)
details.text: Commission models are assigned per apartment rather than per user. Model A offers ₪15 listing fee + ₪25/rental within a 12-month rolling window (up to ₪265+). Model B offers ₪25 upfront + ₪40 on the first confirmed rental with lifetime validity.

details.heading: 7-Day Decision Deadline & Rate Lock
details.text: Ambassadors have a strict 7-day countdown on their dashboard to select between Model A and Model B before system auto-defaults. Commission rates are contractually locked for 12 months.

details.heading: 1-Level Sub-Ambassador & Reversal Ledgers
details.text: Ambassador A earns a ₪5 bonus when referred Ambassador B attributes a property. Financial ledgers are strictly immutable, supporting negative reversal entries upon booking cancellations.

details.heading: Torah Portion (Parshiyot) Selector
details.text: Hosts check off upcoming Shabbatot by religious portion (e.g., Parshat Bereshit, Parshat Noach, Parshat Eikev) instead of selecting obscure Gregorian dates.

details.heading: Automated Weekly Readiness Bot
details.text: Configurable notification daemon messaging hosts every week (e.g., Thursday at 18:00) via SMS or Email prompting: 'Is your apartment ready for this Shabbat? Tap here to toggle availability.'

details.heading: Report Rented & ₪50 Success Fee
details.text: Hosts report off-platform or direct bookings via 1-click, automatically issuing a transparent ₪50 platform success fee record to support continuous site operations.

subsystems.title: Admin ERP & Community Hotline Hub
subsystems.subtitle: AI Voice Hotline Ingestion & Printable Synagogue Bulletins

details.heading: Voice Inbox with AI Speech-to-Text
details.text: Ingests telephone voicemails from kosher phone users, generating audio players, full speech-to-text transcripts, AI summaries, and automated callback tasks.

details.heading: Print-Ready PDF Synagogue Flyer Generator
details.text: 1-click generation of high-contrast printable PDF notices containing apartment specs, kosher amenities, and hotline tear-off tabs for community synagogue notice boards.

details.heading: ₪50 Debt Collection & Commission Audit
details.text: Master ledger tracking open debts with automated reminder counters alongside approval interfaces for ambassador payouts and financial reversals.

dualCommission.sectionTitle: The Dual Commission Architecture (Model A vs. Model B)
dualCommission.sectionDesc: Unlike generic affiliate plugins that tie commissions to the promoter profile, ShabbosRent calculates commissions per property listing. An ambassador can have Property #1 on Model A and Property #2 on Model B.

modelA.title: Model A — Recurring Yield
modelA.desc: Best suited for prime, high-frequency metropolitan properties in Jerusalem or Tzfat. The ambassador receives ₪15 upon approved listing, then ₪25 for every single rental completed within a 365-day rolling window.

modelB.title: Model B — High Upfront Bounty
modelB.rate: ₪25 Listing Fee + ₪40 on First Confirmed Rental
modelB.desc: Best suited for occasional holiday accommodations. The promoter receives ₪25 on listing approval plus a guaranteed ₪40 bounty upon the very first booking, regardless of whether it happens in month 1 or month 24.

dualCommission.contractRules: Strict 7-Day Model Lock Countdown • 12-Month Rate Freeze • ₪5 Sub-Ambassador Listing Bonus • Immutable Ledger Reversals
